column1: # Sovereignty planet yields (SOV-RES, #78): what each planet TYPE gives a hub's
# system. Authored by us: every number is [A]. The client has display bands for
# these quantities (orbitalSkyhook/resourceRichness.py [V]); ours are scaled to
# those bands [I], so a planet reads as modest, average or abundant, not as
# zero. Upgrade costs (L6) must fit this scale. Read by the server
# (`sov_resources::PLANETS`); edit and restart; no re-extract needed. An edit
# changes the served definitions version (a hash of this table), so clients
# ask again.
# planet_type_id: the catalogue's planet type id (an identifier, not a value).
# A row gives exactly ONE kind: power, or workforce, or a reagent. Rows that
# give none or two are dropped and logged.
# reagent_type_id: `-` (or 0) for none, else the colony reagent's item type id
# (an identifier, as the planet type ids are; the client's
# typeColonyReagentIce / typeColonyReagentLava, inventorycommon/const.py [V]).
# Each id is checked on first use against typedata group 4729; a miss is
# logged and that planet gives no reagent.
# amount_per_cycle, cycle_s (must be above 0: the client divides by it),
# secured_pct (0-100), secured_cap, unsecured_cap: the reagent definition, and
# 0 for a row that is not a reagent.
# why: the [A] and its falsifier.
# Planet types: 11 temperate, 12 ice, 13 gas, 2014 oceanic, 2015 lava,
# 2016 barren, 2017 storm, 2063 plasma. A type with no row (the two rare ones)
# gives nothing.
planet_type_id

column10: [A] gas gives power, hundreds per planet; falsifier: owner balance ruling
[A] plasma gives more power than gas; falsifier: owner balance ruling
[A] temperate gives workforce, low thousands; falsifier: owner balance ruling
[A] oceanic gives workforce; falsifier: owner balance ruling
[A] barren gives workforce; falsifier: owner balance ruling
[A] storm gives workforce; falsifier: owner balance ruling
[A] ice gives the ice colony reagent, tens per hour; falsifier: owner balance ruling
[A] lava gives the lava colony reagent, hundreds per hour; falsifier: owner balance ruling
